about: Ground truth for the Kavach dataset. Sahyadri Bank is fictional. Ring ids, the words 'mule', 'victim' and 'ring', and any label from this file must NEVER be copied into the generated data.

bank_policy_facts.card_hotlisting: immediately on request, via app, IVR or agent
bank_policy_facts.shadow_credit_or_decision_tat: 10 working days from the complaint for reported unauthorised electronic transactions
bank_policy_facts.zero_liability_window: customer reports within 3 working days of being informed of the transaction (fraud not due to customer negligence)
bank_policy_facts.limited_liability_window: 4 to 7 working days - liability capped as per the bank's board-approved policy
bank_policy_facts.beneficiary_lien: bank requests a lien/freeze on the beneficiary account via the beneficiary's bank
bank_policy_facts.senior_citizen_priority: callback within 4 working hours; case handled by the senior-citizen desk
bank_policy_facts.failed_upi_auto_reversal: T+1 working day; compensation of Rs 100 per day of delay beyond that
bank_policy_facts.atm_cash_not_dispensed: auto-reversal within 5 working days; Rs 100 per day compensation beyond that

demo_customer.story: 61-year-old retired teacher in Kothrud, Pune. Writes in Hinglish, prefers replies in Hindi. On demo day she reports the R1 scam LIVE - her fraud complaint must NOT exist in the data. Her two fraudulent UPI payments this morning DO exist in the transaction records.

prior_interactions.summary: Forwarded the 'KYC EXPIRED' SMS from sender VK-SHYKYC and asked if it was genuine. The agent said the bank never asks for KYC through SMS links or phone calls and told her not to call the number. No case opened; chat closed as 'Query - resolved'.
prior_interactions.forwarded_sms_text: Dear Customer, your Sahyadri Bank KYC has EXPIRED today & a/c will be BLOCKED within 24 hrs. Update immediately, call KYC officer +91 59749 55543

fraud_rings.scam_script: An SMS says the Sahyadri Bank KYC has expired and the account will be blocked; the caller poses as the bank's KYC cell, asks the customer to install AnyDesk 'for video KYC', then moves money over UPI while screen-sharing, sometimes asking for the OTP 'to confirm KYC'.

scammer_contacts.persona: Vikas Sharma, 'KYC Verification Cell, Sahyadri Bank Head Office'

scammer_contacts.sample_text: Dear Customer, your Sahyadri Bank KYC has EXPIRED today & a/c will be BLOCKED within 24 hrs. Update immediately, call KYC officer +91 59749 55543

fraud_rings.scam_script: An SMS threatens power disconnection tonight over an 'unpaid bill'; the 'electricity officer' has the victim install TeamViewer QuickSupport or a 'Bill Update' APK and pay a small 'update fee', then drains the account.

scammer_contacts.persona: 'Lineman supervisor' who calls back victims who hesitate

scammer_contacts.sample_text: Dear Consumer, your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM because your previous month bill was not updated. Please immediately contact our electricity officer +91 58223 45998. Thank you

recalls_in_complaint.app_or_channel: a 'Bill Update' APK file sent on WhatsApp
a 'Bill Update' APK file sent on WhatsApp

fraud_rings.modus_operandi: Fake customer-care number + UPI collect request
fraud_rings.scam_script: The victim searches online for QuickCart or FoodDash customer care to get a refund, reaches a fake helpline, and is told to approve a UPI collect request or scan a QR code 'to receive the refund' - entering the UPI PIN sends money instead.

scammer_contacts.persona: fake 'QuickCart customer care' number shown on a search-results page
fake 'FoodDash refund desk' number from a social-media ad

fraud_rings.scam_script: A WhatsApp message offers Rs 150 per 'like the video' task; the victim joins a Telegram group, gets small payouts at first, then is asked to pay escalating 'prepaid task' deposits that are never returned.

scammer_contacts.persona: 'HR Riya', admin of the 'Daily Earn 5000' Telegram group
WhatsApp number that sends the first 'like videos, earn Rs 150 per task' message
